scope: Bounded front-edge regrasp diagnostic; not whole-table coverage.
finding: Six reset-only overhangs remained stable. No donor delivery or physical regrasp was launched. Two receiver poses solved IK but intersected the table and were refused.
retained_incident: The invalid-reset incident and its correction are preserved; corrected runs reject invalid resets before stepping and keep the unchanged contact guards.
interpretation: The diagnostic distinguishes supported reset geometry from manipulation feasibility and does not prove universal physical impossibility.
